title: Likely bug in sending duration for profileSwitch, mongodb has different duration value
symptom: While extracting data from mongodb, and going through {eventType : Profile Switch}, the duration is not properly represented in milliseconds and seems like there is a dual conversion from minutes to milliseconds (60*1000 * 60*1000). The duration on mongodb is reported as 2592000000000 which equals to 720 mins if divided by (60*1000 * 60*1000). The user wonders if this bug is related to profiles not switching off.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the issue is identified as a bug in sending duration for profileSwitch, and a fix commit is referenced.
